situation (example wording): "Dallas vs Houston murders per month", "San Francisco and New Orleans auto theft per month", "San Francisco auto theft per month according to NIBRS"
what the app does today: Several agencies by month were built from NIBRS (a table of blank months where an agency had no NIBRS reports); one agency by month fell to NIBRS without saying so when Current Trends lacked the agency or the latest month.
proposed behavior: Crime Index (Current Trends for months) is the source by default and for the whole table: several named agencies by month for a Part I count are one table Agency | Month | count with one source line; an agency or month with no figure is blank, never 0, with the line "No figure is available for ... for <agency>: shown blank, not zero." No years named: every month in the data, said. One agency by month never falls to NIBRS by itself: an agency Current Trends has nothing for is a blank table, and a month after its latest is declined with NIBRS offered by name. NIBRS is used only when asked for by name; then an agency with no NIBRS data is declined: "NIBRS has no data from the San Francisco Police Department in this period." (several: "NIBRS has no data from San Francisco and New Orleans in this period.") with one button, the question as asked (it then runs from Crime Index). Exception: a plain murder or homicide count by month for one agency comes from Homicide Reports from 1985, unless the whole span is inside Current Trends (D37 and D42, Jeff 2026-11-14).
exact default or choices offered: "Dallas vs Houston murders per month" is a Crime Index table from January 2017; "... according to NIBRS" for an agency with no reports is declined with Crime Index offered.
why: Jeff 2026-11-15 via coordinator: "Again, why would this run in NIBRS? This should be filled by Crime Index, if they ask for NIBRS specifically then it should decline and offer Crime Index as the only option." The decline wording approved as written.
test cases: Tests that ask its example question: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts.
